description: This file is a script for analyzing dependencies within the Notesnook project, including functions to find dependencies recursively and compare dependency versions across different packages.

methods.name: analyzePackages
methods.description: Analyzes a list of dependencies, reads their package.json files, and compares dependency versions.

methods.name: findDependencies
methods.description: Recursively finds all dependencies starting from a given scope, including local file dependencies and scoped packages.

methods.name: filterDependencies
methods.description: Filters dependencies to include only those starting with '@notesnook/' or specified as local files.
